title: Hospital admissions for malaria per 1,000 employees of the Panama Canal, 1906 to 1913
description: Bar chart, admissions per 1,000 employees a year: 821 in 1906, 426 in 1907, 282 in 1908, 215 in 1909, 187 in 1910, 184 in 1911, 110 in 1912 and 76 in 1913. Data: William C. Gorgas, Sanitation in Panama (1915), p. 275.
heading: MALARIA ADMISSIONS PER 1,000 CANAL EMPLOYEES

source.container: William C. Gorgas, Sanitation in Panama (New York: D. Appleton, 1915), p. 275
